after: process c paused in its generation 2 (it resumes after this experiment, under its own registration); before any registered run of the open design
decisions: The open design (rsi6/learner/design_o.py) and the discovery of its mechanisms (rsi6/open/) are registered in rsi6/registry/registration_o.json and run by rsi6/open/experiment.py on the working ledger, stage by stage: discovery, selection, swap, held-out; then, after the sealed target test of the earlier processes, the later held-out stage.

The open design runs only on categories of the source pool until the sealed target test of the earlier processes has run. Its later held-out stage on the six categories of that test is registered now, with its seeds.

Process c is not changed. It is stopped while the open experiment runs, because two drivers do not write one ledger, and started again afterwards; every one of its measurements is served from the ledger on the restart.
